intro: We list {{count}} MBA / PGDM colleges in Gujarat where our records show a highest package of at least ₹{{threshold}} lakh. All three — IIM Ahmedabad, MICA and IBS Gujarat — are in Ahmedabad.

This is a short set of MBA colleges in Gujarat with ₹50 lakh highest package in our file. IIM Ahmedabad leads the top MBA colleges in Gujarat 2026, but a highest figure is still one offer, not a batch average.
listLead: With only three colleges, compare the programme and the year, not just the headline number. MICA's fee card may show a certificate course even though the qualifying placement row is its PGDM.
snapshot: IIM Ahmedabad's official IPRS-audited Finals 2025 PGP report lists a combined maximum earning potential with a mean of ₹35.50 LPA and a highest of ₹110 LPA. That is the row which now meets this threshold.
MICA's PGDM in Communication Management has a 2022 highest of ₹58 LPA in our file, and IBS Gujarat's PGPM Finance has a 2022 highest of ₹53 LPA. Both years are now a few cycles old.
firstCollegesLead: IIM Ahmedabad is 1st and MICA is 33rd in the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking. The MICA card may display a post-graduate certificate fee of ₹1.30 lakh, which is not the fee for the two-year PGDM.

compare.heading: How to read highest-package figures in Gujarat
paragraphs: IIM Ahmedabad, MICA and IBS Gujarat serve different applicants. A flagship MBA, a communications PGDM and a campus of IBS are not interchangeable, even when each has cleared this threshold in our file.
bullets: Use the official IPRS 2025 average and highest together: a mean of ₹35.50 LPA and a highest of ₹110 LPA. A single top offer is not a typical IIM Ahmedabad outcome.
Confirm the programme on the fee card, especially at MICA, where a certificate course can appear instead of the PGDM.
Open the latest official placement report, because two of the three qualifying years in our file are 2022.

faqs.question: Which MBA colleges in Gujarat with ₹50 lakh highest package are listed here?
faqs.answer: {{count}} colleges, all in Ahmedabad: IIM Ahmedabad, MICA and IBS Gujarat. Each has a programme in our records with a highest package of ₹{{threshold}} lakh or more.

faqs.question: What is IIM Ahmedabad's NIRF rank?
faqs.answer: IIM Ahmedabad is 1st in the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking. That rank is for the institute, and it does not by itself tell you the fee or the typical package.

faqs.question: Is the official IIM Ahmedabad highest package a typical salary?
faqs.answer: The official IPRS 2025 combined maximum-earning-potential table lists a mean of ₹35.50 LPA, a median of about ₹34.60 LPA and a highest of ₹110 LPA. Confirm any later official report before you decide.

faqs.question: Why does MICA show a low fee on its card?
faqs.answer: The fee we hold is for a post-graduate certificate programme, not for the two-year PGDM in Communication Management. Check the official PGDM fee notice before you compare costs.
